calculate_nDCG: calculate the normalized Discounted Cumulative Gain between a similarity matrix and relevancy matrix for ranking evaluation
calculate_DCG: calculate the Discounted Cumulative Gain score for each query using similarity, relevancy, and k_counts matrices
calculate_IDCG: calculate the Ideal Discounted Cumulative Gain for perfect retrieval using a relevancy matrix and k_counts
calculate_k_counts: calculate the k_counts mask matrix from a relevancy matrix to determine valid retrieval items per query
test_nDCG_module: run the nDCG module self-test to verify calculate_k_counts, calculate_nDCG, calculate_DCG, and calculate_IDCG assertions
